messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: release/payment-gateway-staging canary failed on pod readiness (v2.3.2) - 3/5 replicas not Ready

marta: seeing it, loadbalancer health shows flapping after post-install hooks ran
jim: what changed in 2.3.2? I thought it was a small chart bump for hook ordering only
sasha: chart diff shows `templates/hooks/post-upgrade-job.yaml` moved earlier in the hook ordering and `configmap` keys were serialized in different order by helm library bump
ryan: tl;dr: configmap key ordering caused app to reload and lose leader lock briefly -> readiness fail

marta: can we avoid a full rollback? traffic hasn't been hit hard in staging but we should be quick
alec: two options: 1) rollback chart to v2.3.1 (chart bump) or 2) pin chart to v2.3.1 and apply a values-only patch with new image tag if needed
jim: rollback would re-run hooks too though, could be noisy. values-only patch would avoid touching hook ordering
sasha: agree. we can patch `values.release.disablePostUpgradeJob: true` as a temporary guard and push image tag fix via values. then pin chart version in the release config
marta: command to apply quick values override?
ryan: run: `helm upgrade --reuse-values payment-gateway ./charts/payment-gateway --namespace staging --set release.disablePostUpgradeJob=true --set image.tag=2026-03-19-hotfix`
ryan: and also update our helmfile/terraform helm_release to pin chartVersion = "2.3.1" for now
marta: @oncall-bot can you run the preflight checks after deploy?
oncall-bot: preflight started: checking pod status, ingress, service endpoints, and readiness over 5m window

jim: also add a short note in release notes: "temporary disable of post-upgrade job due to hook ordering regression in chart 2.3.2; chart pinned to 2.3.1 pending fix"
sasha: opening a PR to revert the library bump that changed hook serialization and add unit tests for configmap deterministic ordering
alec: timeline: do values patch now, monitor for 15m, if healthy we'll merge the pin to infra repo and schedule chart fix for tomorrow change window (UTC afternoon)
marta: doing the helm upgrade now

deploy-bot: starting helm upgrade job (run_id=gh-3421)

deploy-bot: helm upgrade completed: 1/5 pods Ready -> 4/5 Ready (canary step 1 OK)

marta: looks stable so far, no restarts in the last 2m
ryan: patching infra repo with chart pin and short release note blurb

alec: good decision to values-patch instead of rollback. we'll treat chart bump as hotfix candidate and include regression tests

marta: filing postmortem blurb and linking PRs in the release thread

oncall-bot: preflight passed. marking canary as healthy. :white_check_mark:
